decisions.reason: The existing same-message CAD update includes bowl clearance and whisk height but omits the explicitly requested fast, preferably tool-free whisk-removal constraint that the refined layout must accommodate.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
As you continue refining the layout, there are several details I want us to get right:

• Bowl removal — the bowls should lift out easily without being obstructed by the whisk or motor assembly.

• Whisk removal — ideally, detaching it should be fast and straightforward, without tools if possible, because cleaning and swapping parts during events will matter.

• Whisk positioning — setting the correct height will be important for producing good foam and limiting splashes, particularly with the higher RPM range.

• Splash control — because we selected a more powerful motor, the machine needs to remain clean while operating, whether that is achieved through positioning, bowl geometry, or a discreet guard if required.

Everything looks great so far. I just want these usability details optimized for actual event use.

value_updates.whisk_height_layout_constraint: The layout must support setting the whisk at the correct height for good foam and limited splashing, particularly at higher RPM.
value_updates.bowl_removal_clearance: System layout and CAD must allow the bowls to lift out easily without obstruction from the whisk or motor assembly.
value_updates.whisk_removal_layout_constraint: System layout and CAD must accommodate fast and straightforward whisk detachment, preferably without tools, for cleaning and part swapping during events.
